feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: How colleges are creating programs for a changing U.S. job market
entry.summary: What do influencing, AI and health sciences have in common? They're all degree programs colleges have launched in the last few years to attract students looking for a new career path.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer
entry.summary: The Vatican announced that Pope's diagnosis of lung cancer following surgery

entry.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign among corruption allegations
entry.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle has been asked to resign as US ambassador to Greece following allegations that she sought payment from a Trump donor in exchange for access to administration officials

entry.title: President Trump's Ohio campaign ads have hit a roadblock
entry.summary: President Trump has his eyes on Ohio, traveling there twice this week during a week packed with campaign stops. But his pro-Trump ads have hit a roadblock.

entry.title: Why does Pete Hegseth want to livestream an execution?
entry.summary: Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has proposed livestreaming the execution of a man convicted of the 2009 attack on Fort Hood. Some scholars say the idea is rooted in his religious background.

entry.title: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has broken a landmark distance record
entry.summary: NASA's Mars rover Perseverance has just hit a milestone — for the longest distance traveled by an off-Earth vehicle.

entry.title: Researchers are tracking Monarch butterflies to learn more about their journey
entry.summary: Researchers all over North America are attaching tiny transmitters to Monarch butterflies as they begin their migration to Mexico, to learn more about their stops and challenges.

entry.title: 'Breaking Bad' actor RJ Mitte has died at 34
entry.summary: The actor RJ Mitte has died. Best known for his role on Breaking Bad as Walter White's son, Mitte brought disability awareness to the hit show with his experience with cerebral palsy. He was 34.

entry.title: How will a diesel deal with Russia impact the U.S. market?
entry.summary: The price of diesel hit an all-time high in the U.S. in September. Can President Trump's deal for Russia to release more diesel onto the market bring the price down?

entry.title: An update on the protests in India
entry.summary: There's a political standoff in India between the government and protesters over a controversial revision of the country's voter rolls
